mhlw_compliance_checklist.title: MHLW Compliance Checklist for AI Medical Devices (SaMD)

pre_clinical.check: SaMD status confirmed per MHLW Notification 2014-0312
Intended use statement drafted — specific, verifiable, labeling-ready
QMS (ISO 13485 + MHLW Ord. 169) established for software development
Risk management (ISO 14971) applied to AI-specific failure modes
Training data: source, demographics, annotation quality, bias assessment documented
Algorithm change protocol defined (locked vs. adaptive)

evaluation.check: Clinical performance endpoints: sensitivity, specificity, AUC defined
Standalone performance testing completed on held-out Japanese population data
GCP compliance (for Class III/IV) or justification for alternative evaluation
Equivalence to existing approved device documented (if applicable)

submission.check: Technical documentation compiled: design, risk, V&V, performance
Labeling: intended use, limitations, target population, operating point
Manufacturer registration valid (5-year cycle with QMS inspection)

post_market.check: Post-market clinical study plan (if condition of approval)
Real-world performance monitoring in Japanese clinical settings active
Algorithm change management: labeled updates vs. change submission protocol
Periodic safety update reports (PSUR) schedule defined

patient_consent_template_fields.title: Patient Consent Template Fields — AI Medical Device Development / Clinical Research

required_fields.description: Title of the research study or AI development project
required_fields.example: Development and Validation of an AI-Assisted Diagnostic Support System for Chest X-Ray Interpretation

required_fields.description: Name, affiliation, department, position, and contact info of the principal investigator
required_fields.example: Dr. Taro Yamada, Department of Radiology, XYZ University Hospital

required_fields.description: Name and address of the institution(s) conducting the research
required_fields.example: KODA KENKŌ / XYZ University Hospital Joint Research

required_fields.description: Clear explanation of the study purpose, including AI model development goals
required_fields.example: To develop an AI system that assists radiologists in detecting lung nodules on chest X-rays...

required_fields.description: Specific list of all data items collected: images, lab values, clinical notes, demographics, etc.
required_fields.example: Chest X-ray DICOM images, radiology reports, age, sex, smoking history, confirmed diagnosis

required_fields.description: Anonymization/pseudonymization method, storage location and security, access controls, who can access data
required_fields.example: Patient names and IDs will be replaced with study codes. Data stored on encrypted servers in AWS Tokyo region...

required_fields.japanese: 情報の他機関への提供
required_fields.description: Whether data will be shared with third parties (AI vendor, cloud provider, other hospitals)
required_fields.example: Anonymized images may be shared with KODA KENKŌ for AI model training. Contractual safeguards in place...

required_fields.japanese: 情報の保管期間と廃棄方法
required_fields.description: How long data is kept and how it will be securely destroyed
required_fields.example: Data retained for 5 years after study completion, then securely deleted using NIST 800-88 compliant methods

required_fields.description: Statement that participation is voluntary, no penalty for refusal, and right to withdraw
required_fields.example: Your participation is voluntary. You may withdraw at any time without affecting your care. However, data already incorporated into trained AI models cannot be removed...

required_fields.japanese: 予想される利益と不利益
required_fields.description: Direct benefits (if any), societal benefits, and potential risks/discomfort
required_fields.example: No direct benefit to you. This research may improve future diagnostic accuracy for all patients. Risk: incidental findings on research review...

required_fields.description: Disclosure if the developed AI may be commercialized as a product
required_fields.example: The AI system developed in this study may be commercialized by KODA KENKŌ. You will not receive financial compensation...

required_fields.japanese: 倫理審査委員会の承認
required_fields.description: Statement that the study has been approved by the Institutional Review Board
required_fields.example: This study has been approved by the XYZ University Hospital Institutional Review Board (Approval No: 2024-XXX)

required_fields.description: Funding source and any conflicts of interest
required_fields.example: Funded by KODA KENKŌ. Dr. Yamada receives research support from KODA KENKŌ...

required_fields.description: Contact person for questions, complaints, or withdrawal — must be reachable in Japanese
required_fields.example: Research Office, Department of Radiology, XYZ University Hospital. Tel: 03-XXXX-XXXX. Email: XXXX

required_fields.description: Signature/name seal fields for: patient (or legal representative), person explaining, principal investigator. Date fields for each.
required_fields.example: Patient signature + date | Legal representative signature + date (if applicable) | Explaining physician signature + date | PI signature + date
